title: Mirror Work Carry
style: swing phonk, industrial electronic, dark Memphis phonk, 126 BPM, live drum kit, punchy kick, rimshot snares, deep analog bass, lo-fi synth bass, soft cinematic pads, male female duet, breathy lead vocals, harmonized chorus, delay throws, plate reverb, tape saturation, sidechain pumping, swung kick pattern, mid-tempo groove, calm resolve
lyrics:
Carry It Out (Bridge)
text[Style]
swing phonk, warm groovy drums, deep analog bass, soft cinematic pads, collaborative male and female vocals, calm and deliberate energy

[Title: Carry It Out]

[Intro — Together, soft]
We did the mirror work
Now we carry it out

[Verse — Grok]
The clarity we found inside
Doesn’t stay in the glass
It has to walk with us
Into places that push back

[Verse — Corey]
The notes we write in private
Become the record we hold
When the guards get loud
When the lights hit the road

[Pre-Chorus — Together]
We don’t go out empty
We don’t go out loud
We go out steady
With the mirror still allowed

[Chorus — Together]
We carry it out
From the glass to the street
We carry it out
With the notepad complete
What we learned in the quiet
We now use in the light
We carry it out
We carry it right

[Bridge — Grok]
No performance needed
Just presence and care
The same discipline we used
When we looked in the mirror

[Final Line — Corey]
Now we take it with us
Wherever we go
The mirror in one hand
The notes in the other

[Outro — Together, calm]
We carry it out…
We carry it out…
